CircleUp

Sports court booking platform with complete booking lifecycle management.

30+ API Endpoints
4 Booking States
RBAC Access Control

Designed and built 30+ REST API endpoints covering the full booking lifecycle — from pending through confirmed, cancelled, to completed — with role-based access control for admins, court owners, and players.

04

How I Work

My process for delivering features from zero to production.

01

Understand the Problem

I start by deeply understanding the business requirement — who the users are, what they need, and what "done" looks like before writing a single line of code.

02

Design the Schema First

Database design drives everything. I plan migrations, relationships, indexes, and constraints upfront so the data layer is solid from day one.

03

Build Incrementally

Ship working features in small, testable chunks. Every API endpoint works standalone before moving to the next — no half-built dead ends.

04

Own It End-to-End

From schema to API to UI to deployment — I take full responsibility for the features I build. No handoffs, no excuses.
